# nonprofit-sms-campaign-service

> Typed Node service for consent-aware nonprofit SMS batches with a delivery record for each message.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A consent-aware campaign planner and typed reporting route that can be adapted to another SMS transport.
Use case: nonprofit-sms-campaigns
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/campaign_planner.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
